LESSON: DESCANT RECORDER

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: Performing and Displaying
Topic 2.5: Descant Recorder

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Descant Recorder. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can a good tone be produced on the descant recorder?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the parts of a descant recorder for familiarisation
2. care for a descant recorder for longevity
3. enjoy playing melodies using the descant recorder

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: DESCANT RECORDER
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS · Grade: Grade 4
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Descant Recorder helps you succeed in CREATIVE ARTS. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: DESCANT RECORDER
Study Descant Recorder like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Identify the parts of a descant recorder for familiarisation

What this means
In this part you learn to identify the parts of a descant recorder for familiarisation. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify the parts of a descant recorder for familiarisation.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Descant Recorder” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify the parts of a descant recorder for familiarisation. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Care for a descant recorder for longevity

What this means
In this part you learn to care for a descant recorder for longevity. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: care for a descant recorder for longevity.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Descant Recorder in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can care for a descant recorder for longevity. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Enjoy playing melodies using the descant recorder

What this means
In this part you learn to enjoy playing melodies using the descant recorder. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: enjoy playing melodies using the descant recorder.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can enjoy playing melodies using the descant recorder. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Descant Recorder is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Descant Recorder” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: identify the parts of a descant recorder for familiarisation)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Descant Recorder in your own words. (skill: care for a descant recorder for longevity)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: enjoy playing melodies using the descant recorder)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Descant Recorder to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify the parts of a descant recorder for familiarisation.
3. Practise this skill: care for a descant recorder for longevity.
4. Practise this skill: enjoy playing melodies using the descant recorder.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Descant Recorder from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Descant Recorder: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 4 learner study Descant Recorder?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can a good tone be produced on the descant recorder?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Descant Recorder means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify the parts of a descant recorder for familiarisation.
5. Be able to: care for a descant recorder for longevity.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
